summary:
Accounts & Finance professional with 8+ years of experience in GST compliance, indirect
taxation, statutory filings, reconciliations, audits, and financial reporting across multiple
states. Proven expertise in managing end-to-end indirect tax processes, audit coordination
and financial auditing.Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience in multiple software.
Currently working as Manager - Finance & Accounts in a large NBFC environment.

bullets: Truhome Finance Limited (Formerly Shriram Housing Finance Limited), Mumbai, India
Ensure timely and accurate preparation, filing, and reconciliation of GST returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-6 , GSTR-9&9C) for multiple registration.
Prepare and maintain monthly reconciliation of GSTR-2B with purchase data; coordinate with cross-functional teams to resolve ITC mismatches within timelines.
Manage reconciliation of GSTR-6A and ensure accurate state-wise ITC distribution.
Coordinated with consultants, auditors, and internal departments for GST assessments and litigation matters.
Handling tax litigation, GST notices, scrutiny, and departmental queries by preparing detailed requirement and supporting documentation for timely submission for multiple registration.
Monitor GST changes and regulatory updates applicable to NBFC sector and implement the necessary compliance actions.
Ensure timely tax payment and reconciliation with GST portal data.
Manage tax data preparation for internal audit, statutory audit, and GST audit.
Handle GST registrations, amendments, additional place of business updates, and cancellations.
Improve GST reconciliation process, reducing errors and compliance risks.
Strengthen vendor GST compliance monitoring, helping the organization avail and avoid to loss of ITC claims.
Lead automation initiatives and ERP integrations for indirect tax compliance (Oracle, UNO, etc.).
Prepare and support TDS compliance including filing of Forms 26Q & 27Q.
Monitor TRACES portal for Form 16A downloads, corrections, and return status tracking. Achievement: Awarded Certificate of Appreciation for exemplary contribution to SHFL business - June 2024.
